title: 一致并非对齐：人类与LLM道德判断中的分歧基础
summary: 该研究指出，LLM与人类在道德判断标签上的一致并不能证明其对齐，因为可能基于不同的道德理由。通过500项ETHICS基准测试，分析最终标签和理由，发现模型在理由层面系统性地偏离人类，即使标签一致。因此，标签评估需辅以理由分析，否则可能产生误导。
summary_en: This study argues that agreement in moral judgment labels between LLMs and humans does not imply alignment, as they may rely on different moral grounds. Using a 500-item ETHICS benchmark, analysis of labels and rationales reveals systematic divergence in moral reasoning even when labels match, suggesting label-based evaluation can be misleading without rationale analysis.
